name: KazPE
description: KazPE is a curated and annotated dataset for automated post-editing of Kazakh translations, covering six domains and detailed error classifications, designed to improve machine translation quality for a morphologically rich, low-resource language.
reputation: A specialized low-resource MT evaluation dataset that is cited in Kazakh post-editing research but is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: First structured evaluation framework for Kazakh translation post-editing; dataset publicly released.
